units.notes:
## Votic basics

Votic uses the Latin alphabet with additional **accents**. 

 ## Vocabulary 

| Votic | English |
| --- | --- |
| tere | hi |
| miä õõn | I am |
| siä õõd | you are | 
 | -ko | questions marker | 
 | üvvä omnikkoa | good morning | 
 | üvvä päivää | good afternoon | 
 | üvvä ohtõgoa | good evening | 
 | üvva üüte | good night | 


 ## Verb conjugation 
As you can see from the words for _I am_, and _you are_, we use the stem **õõ** to mean to be. The infinitive (simplest form) of the verb is actually **õlla**, however verb stems often differ greatly from their infinitive in Votic. You might also have noticed, that the endings attached onto **õõ-** change depending on who is doing the action. For _miä_(**I**), this is _-n_, and for _siä_(**you**), this is _-d_. 


 ## Asking questions  
 To ask yes/no questions in Votic, attach the ending _-ko_ onto the verb. For example _siä õõd_ -> _õõdko siä?_
